q: A $6\times6$ stiffness matrix of an unsupported planar truss has rank 3. Which statement is true?
options: Three independent displacement patterns cost no energy: the rigid-body motions
explain: Rank-nullity: $6 - 3 = 3$ null vectors, two translations and a rotation.

q: Lowest natural frequency (rad/s) of two 1 kg masses joined wall–spring–mass–spring–mass with $k = 100$ N/m. 3 decimals.
You need to solve 200 load cases on the same 50 000-unknown sparse SPD stiffness matrix. Best approach?
options: Sparse Cholesky once, then 200 pairs of triangular solves
Gaussian elimination 200 times on the dense matrix
explain: Factor once, reuse the factors; never form the inverse.

q: Least-squares slope of a line through $(0, 1), (1, 3), (2, 4)$.
explain: Normal equations give slope $1.5$ and intercept $1.17$.

q: In the homogeneous transform $\begin{pmatrix} R & \mathbf t \\ \mathbf 0^{\mathsf T} & 1 \end{pmatrix}$, the inverse is…
explain: Undo the translation in the rotated frame: $\mathbf p = R^{\mathsf T}(\mathbf p' - \mathbf t)$.
